stories.title: Italy Survives South Korea in Davis Cup Thriller

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Italy hold off South Korea 2-1 to reach the #DavisCup semis.

Musetti dominated R1 6-0, 7-6(5). After Kwon leveled, Berrettini & Vavassori won a doubles thriller 7-6(2), 7-6(11).

Italy face Czech Republic Friday — chasing a 4th straight title. #TennisFanrecap

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Berrettini and Vavassori saved Italy's Davis Cup title defense.

Down in the second-set tiebreak 11 times before they finally closed it out for a 7-6(11) doubles win.

Italy are still alive. Czech Republic await Friday. #DavisCup #TennisFanrecap
